answer: Progressive quotas work like a graduated license: few rights at first, more as you prove yourself. A new identity begins with 2 work slots; each verified epoch adds 2, up to 40, while a whisper of fake work resets the count to 2 and freezes rewards 6 epochs. Idle 3 epochs and the quota falls back by 4. The marble rule: a comet of instant scale is impossible, because 1,000 high-quota identities need 19 epochs of real work, costing 152,000 units.
